thread:
morgan: heads-up - CI perf gate flagged a regression on the latest release merge (release/2026-03). small-seq bench shows noticeable tail latency increase.
lina: saw the alert. can you paste the numbers?
morgan: perf-bot summary: "small-seq p50 +20%, p95 +33%, qps -11%". reproduced on canary with kv-cache hot.
sam: i pulled a flamegraph on canary. there's a new hot-call in kernel_selector.cpp: evaluate_fallback() is being invoked per-token on short sequences now. looks like an early-change to handle long-seq flows accidentally applied to small-seq path.
rahul: that fits my local: increased CPU sys time, more memcpy and thread wakeups. also batching decision changed to spawn micro-batches when tail > 25ms, so more context switches for bursts of 1-8 token requests.
morgan: both changes landed in the same PR (PR 4177 from rahul). splitting will be needed. can we bisect which chunk causes most harm?
lina: quick repro: revert kernel-selector extra check -> p50 back within 3% baseline, p95 improves 20% but qps still -4%. revert batching tweak instead -> p50 improves slightly but p95 still high. suggests kernel-selector is primary.
rahul: ack, that check was added to prefer a larger-kernel early for long sequences. i didn't expect fallback logic to run for every step on cached kernels. my bad. will open revert.
morgan: can we gate the revert? steps: 1) open emergency revert for kernel-selector lines 2) add unit that asserts evaluate_fallback() short-circuits for cached-kernel and small seqs 3) add micro-bench to perf gate that simulates kv-cache warm tiny outputs with jitter.
perf-bot: created PERF-1012: "Short-seq tail with unintended fallback calls" and opened issue link.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-15T11:24 for candidate build completed.
rahul: PR 4182 opened to revert the evaluate_fallback changes. leaving batching tweak in feature branch.
lina: i sketched the micro-bench: 1-8 token outputs, kv-cache primed, Poisson arrival jitter 5-50ms, measure p50/p95/qps. propose thresholds: p50 <= baseline+6%, p95 <= baseline+12%, qps >= baseline-8%.
morgan: add that micro-bench to perf-gate as a separate harness. also add deterministic seeding and a kv-cache priming step so CI noise reduces.
sam: added flamegraph capture hook on perf failures so we can attach profiles to the CI failing run. helps with root cause instead of guessing.
rahul: rolling revert to canary now. will watch perf-bot.
perf-bot: linked PR 4182 to PERF-1012 and scheduled canary perf run.
morgan: postmortem action items (short):
- merge revert 4182 (rahul) and hold prod rollout until micro-bench + thresholds in (lina)
- add unit test ensuring evaluate_fallback early-return on cached-kernel (rahul)
- add deterministic kv-cache priming + seeding to small-seq bench (lina)
- capture flamegraphs on perf gate failures (sam)
- update perf-gate threshold algorithm: use 7-day median + configurable margin per-harness (lina/morgan)
rahul: lesson learned: avoid bundling fallback/kernels changes with batching heuristics in same PR. will keep batching change behind feature flag until validated.
lina: i'll tighten the small-seq harness thresholds and ensure the benchmark runs on every PR touching kernel selection or batching.
morgan: thanks all. i'll post the summary in eng-runtime and add links to PERF-1012 and PR 4182. follow-ups tracked in the issue. :white_check_mark:
